_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro: O jẹ oṣere {player_id}, ti o nṣire {num_rounds} awọn iyipo ti Iterated Ultimatum Game. O ni ${pool} lati pin iyipo yii laarin ara rẹ ati oṣere {other_id}. Olufunni: - Ṣe ipese kan: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool) - Ti o ba gba → O gba $ ((pool - X), oṣere miiran gba $ X - Ti o ba kọ → Awọn mejeeji gba $ 0 - Apẹẹrẹ: [Offer: $3] tabi 'Mo ro pe eyi jẹ ododo. [Offer: $5]' Oluranlowo: - Pinnu lori ipese pẹlu boya [Accept] tabi [Reject] - Apẹẹrẹ: 'O dabi ẹni ti o tọ. [Accept]' 'Kọ si aiṣedeede. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Round {round_number} begins! ---
Player {proposer_id} is the proposer, Player {responder_id} is the responder.
round.offer: Ìyí {round_number}: Ẹ̀yin {proposer_id} fi ${offer} fún Ẹ̀yin {responder_id} (tí ó sì pa ${keep}).
round.accepted: Player {responder_id} ti gba! Round {round_number} gains: Player {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Player {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. New totals: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} rejected the offer! Round {round_number} gains: Both players +$0. Totals remain: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Olùfèrò gbọdọ ṣe ìfèrò nípa lílo àdàkọ [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Iye tí a fi ń rajà ní láti jẹ iye tó péye.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Àmọ̀ṣe náà gbọdọ̀ wà láàrin $0 àti ${pool}.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Olùdáhùn gbọdọ̀ [Accept] tàbí [Reject] fún ọ̀rọ̀ náà.

outcome.win: Player {winner} won with ${winner_total} total vs Player {loser}'s ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Àgbá! Àwọn agbábọ́ọ̀lù méjèèjì parí pẹ̀lú ${total} ní àpapọ̀.
